cc:Work.dc:description: Ranks zero through four are drawn as a scalar, row, matrix, stacked matrices and image batches. Shapes are (), (E,), (N,F), (N,L,E), and (N,C,H,W), with each symbol defined.

g.text: A tensor adds axes, not mystery.

g.text: Rank counts axes. Shape tells you the size and meaning of each axis.
